# Forced address collection and exact-case test counts do not prove deduplication

skipCheckExisting deliberately bypasses lookup and permits creation even if a matching address exists. The inspected force-collection test counts exact primaryEmail equality, so its differently cased address assertion cannot prove case-insensitive global deduplication. Keep force behavior separate from the default lookup contract when writing tests or comments. This is static source and test-code inspection. Full Bugzilla and historical review timeline/inline context remain pending. No Thunderbird runtime, build, lint or live accessibility validation ran.

Scope: mailnews/compose/src.
